title: SINE (Digitone machine)
author: irpina
description: SINE, the smallest machine for the Digitone mk1: a sine at the note, which FOLD folds into brighter waves, with a sub-oscillator an octave down (SUB) and the octave on OCT, on its sounds' SYN1 page. A template for a machine mod: it names no firmware address, so its OS 1.44 port is empty (docs/ADAPTING.md, "Machines on the Digitone"). Needs the machines mod and core-dn1 3.0.
